result:
Round 93 is implemented: in the export dialog, screen readers now hear each option's name and its note separately, and the two silence notes name the format that is actually selected. My unit tests, mutation checks and a short smoke check in Chrome all pass. The C browser rows have not been run yet, so the three bugs stay open until C passes them. Full report: `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-93.md`.

**What changed**
- **D1 (GATE91-S1, A-R86-L7):** in `ArrangementExportDialog.tsx`, the WAV, MP3, WAV + MP3 and disabled video options now have the main text as their name and the note as their description. The disabled range option has the same split, so its reason is no longer read twice. The visible text, classes and test ids are byte-identical.
- **D2 (A-R86-L8):** a new `EXPORT_FORMAT_CREATES` constant. The Master-mute and no-sound notes now say `WAV შეიქმნება`, `MP3 შეიქმნება` or `WAV და MP3 შეიქმნება`. The WAV text is unchanged.
- **New test:** `export-dialog-a11y-copy.test.tsx`, covering AN1–AN6 and NC1–NC3.
- **Docs:** doc 080 line 4 only, and a new doc 081 in Georgian.
- **End state:** HEAD is still `64e12d8`, 2 modified and 2 new files, the 518 frozen files unchanged, no protected file touched. Every change in the dialog is inside the granted regions.

**Tests actually run**
- **New file:** 9/9 pass. Against the old dialog, 7 of 9 fail. The other two (AN4, AN6) check that clicking and label text still work, so they pass on both versions by design.
- **Targeted:** 18 files, 194 tests pass; no frozen test turned red.
- **Static checks:** `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` both exit 0. The scoped Biome check and lint on the two owned code files are clean.
- **Mutations** (in a scratch copy): a–g each turn at least one test red. h (a `block` class on the MP3 name) turns nothing red; that layout drift is C's VIS-LAYOUT check.
- **My smoke** (1440×900, not C evidence): Chrome's accessibility tree gives the exact name and description for MP3, WAV, WAV + MP3 and the disabled range option. No note text appears in any name. Clicking the MP3 text selects MP3. The Master-mute note switches from `WAV შეიქმნება` to `MP3 შეიქმნება`. No hydration warning, no Authorization header, no R2, token or unpkg request.
- **e2e:** no e2e spec selects these options by name, so the change can't break one.

**Not run by me:**
- the full suite, `npm run verify` and the build (left to the gate);
- every C browser row: AX-NAMES (range and loop states, 1280 viewport), VIS-LAYOUT, NOTE-NOSOUND, KEYS-REG, EXPORT-REG and the others.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent gave 9/10 with nothing critical. I fixed its one point in my files: doc 081 wrongly said `useId` ids can't be selected with `#id`. It also noted that the label and description attributes must always be added or removed together; they are today, and nothing needs to change. Its Architecture note for B, verbatim in the report: the test audio stubs are now copied into 61 test files. It proposes one bounded later task to move them into a shared helper module. This round extracts nothing.
